create_sep_vit_model: create a SepViT model for image classification with configurable stages, dimensions, and windowed attention
build_dssa_attention: build a DSSA module that performs separated spatial and window attention with learnable window tokens
create_transformer_block: create a Transformer block with stacked DSSA and FeedForward layers using channel-wise layer normalization
build_feedforward_network: build a FeedForward module with channel-wise layer norm, pointwise convolutions, and GELU activation
test_peg_projection: test a PEG (pixel embedding generation) module that adds local spatial context via depthwise convolution
